owner_words: A+ for D3 only: 10 m cap, 4 m/s wind limit, 160 m radius. Freeze it as a temporary D3 rule. Before any later stage raises the cap, re-derive the limits from measured D3 data, with the ARK Flow MR modelled as the backup velocity source when position is lost.
wind_limit_reading: steady wind on a handheld meter at about 1.5 m above ground, before each flight. The 4 m/s limit covers wind shear up to a power-law exponent of about 0.24 (WO-022 section 2).
exclusion_radius_basis: Option A+ of reports/WO-022-x650-envelope-and-d2-tests.md section 2: 140.3 m measured on the proxy with an estimated delay, and about 160 m with a large tumble (estimated). The fence radius (40 m), overrun margin (9 m), flight box (30 m) and standoffs are unchanged (evals/D3-standoffs-x650.json); the bystander distance beyond fence plus overrun becomes 111 m. The estimated large-tumble case is at the radius, with no margin.
supersedes_for_d3: the exclusion radius and the crew distance in evals/D3-standoffs-x650.json, and the height and wind table in docs/OPERATING_ENVELOPE.md
ends: D3 only. The 10 m cap carries into later stages until the limits are re-derived from measured D3 data, with the ARK Flow MR modelled as the backup velocity source when position is lost.
label: The radius rests on simulation of a proxy and on estimates, not on flight data.
